_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Tiririt da Golf (Urir n Tkeṛṛaṛt) - Amurar {player_id}.
Inadi: Awi aṭas n uṭṭun s ɛeḍḍaḥ n turda tawḥidt. Ma yella tizwiriwin ttwasemman di tazwirt imseḍfer, ttwaḥsabent d 0.
Iɣallen n Tkeṛṛaṛt: A=1, 2-10=azal n tkeṛṛaṛt, J/Q=10, K=0

Tidmamen (seqdec ṣṣenṣert): 
- '[draw]' - Ɛiw si ṭṭṛṛaṛ
- '[take]' - Ɛiw si ṭṭṛṛaṛ n yir ttwasfayen
- '[swap X Y]' - Msebded tkeṛṛaṛt n ṭṭṛṛaṛ s azgen X (amḍiq) Y (tawlaft)
- '[discard]' - Sfey tkeṛṛaṛt n ṭṭṛṛaṛ

board.drew:
Tɛeddeḍ: {card}
Nnig yessefk ad tseqdeceḍ '[swap X Y]' neɣ '[discard]' ayen.
board.took:
Tefkem: {card} si tɣessa n tnekzemt
Tura d ṭṭafem [swap X Y] (ur tzemmer tnekzem)

options.final_turns: Uḍḍunen n uqerru! Isebtar-ik: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ilaq ad: [swap X Y] (ur tezmir ara tkerḍiwin seg uḥric n yigerdan)
options.swap_or_discard: Tura d ṭṭafem: [swap X Y] neɣ [discard]

message.deck_empty: Taɣult tečča, urar ifukk-d ssya ɣer da.
message.knocked: Amyurar {pid} yeɣli! Yal amurad nniḍen yesɛa yiwet n tikelt.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Maḍi kan yiman-nsen iḍerru yiwet n ṭṭaf

invalid.discard_empty: Ur d-yegri ara uḥewwes n yiɣeblan!
invalid.must_draw_first: Tura d ṭṭafem [draw], [take], [knock], neɣ [peek X Y]

invalid.need_drawn_discard: Ilaq-ak takarḍa i d-yettwagezmen akken ad tt-tessufɣeḍ.
